source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: O mors, * ero mors tua, morsus tuus ero, inférne.
text.en: O death, I will be thy death; * O grave, I will be thy destruction.

text.la: Plangent eum * quasi unigénitum, quia ínnocens Dóminus occísus est.
text.en: They shall mourn for Him * as one mourneth for his only son, for the innocent Lord hath been put to death.

text.la: Atténdite * univérsi pópuli, et vidéte dolórem meum.
text.en: O all ye nations, behold * and see my sorrow.

text.la: A porta ínferi * érue, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: O Lord, deliver my soul * from the gates of the grave.

text.la: O vos omnes, * qui transítis per viam, atténdite et vidéte, si est dolor sicut dolor meus.
text.en: O all ye that pass by * behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow.

text.la: Mulíeres * sedéntes ad monuméntum lamentabántur, flentes Dóminum.
text.en: There were women sitting over against the sepulchre * weeping, and making lamentation for the Lord.
